nodes.label: Migration 0007: Chat Delete Adjustments & Read/Unread RPCs
Manual Unread Flag (chat_members.manually_unread)
nodes.rationale: Adds an explicit manually_unread boolean column on chat_members rather than setting last_read_at to NULL because mark_chat_as_read already sets read_at on message_receipts.

nodes.label: Per-Type Chat Deletion RPCs (delete_self_chat / delete_direct_chat_for_me)
nodes.rationale: Uses delete_self_chat to hard-delete self-chats (avoiding orphaned memberless chats) while delete_direct_chat_for_me and relaxed chat_members DELETE policy remove only the user's membership row for direct/group chats.

nodes.label: useChats, useMessageRequests & Realtime Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Fetches up to 200 active chats ordered by pinned_at DESC and last_message_at DESC, batches message_receipts for unread counts and checkmarks, separates pending_request chats into useMessageRequests, and subscribes to messages, chat_members, and message_receipts.

nodes.label: ChatFilters & Scoped Local Search Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Provides 7 URL-persisted filter chips (All, Favorites, Unread, Groups, Archived, Muted, Blocked) and applies 150ms debounced local search after filtering so search is always scoped to the active filter.

nodes.label: ChatListItem & WhatsApp-Style Checkmarks
nodes.rationale: Renders chat rows with deterministic gradient avatars, presence dots, type-prefixed previews, state overrides (deleted, failed, pending, draft), and worst-case delivery/read checkmarks.

nodes.label: MessageRequestsSection (Accept & 7-Day Cooldown Decline)
nodes.rationale: Displays pending message requests above the main chat list when filter is All or Unread; accepting moves the chat to the main list while declining silently removes it and blocks sender retries for 7 days.

nodes.label: ChatContextMenu, MultiSelectToolbar & SwipeActions
nodes.rationale: Combines mobile touch swipe actions, long-press/right-click context menus, desktop hover icons, and a bulk multi-select toolbar for pinning, favoriting, muting, archiving, marking read/unread, blocking, and deleting chats.

nodes.label: LocalStorage Chat Drafts System
nodes.rationale: Stores per-chat drafts synchronously in localStorage['silverchat_draft_{chat_id}'] with a 30-day cleanup so the chat list can render 'Draft: ...' preview overrides immediately without network round-trips.
